sync_policy: Same task semantics and contracts across Skill source, plugin entry and fixed KB snapshot; host-specific display metadata may differ.
atomicity: Skill, KB and plugin updates are separate operations; do not claim atomic success.
rollback: Retain previous plugin release and previous fixed KB locator; restore only from verified compatible snapshot.
publish_gate: All P0 traceability items and read-back checks must pass; NOT_RUN, FAIL or BLOCKED are not PASS.
